measures.title: Tehama County Charter Amendment: Board of Supervisors Salary
measures.summary: Amends the Tehama County Charter to set each county supervisor's annual salary at the California hourly minimum wage times 2,080 hours, starting January 1, 2027. The current charter salary is $1,045 a month ($12,540 a year), last raised by voters in 1989; at the current $16.90 minimum wage the new salary would be $35,152 a year. The salary would rise automatically with the state minimum wage and could otherwise be changed only by voters.
measures.yesMeans: Supervisors' salary would be set at the state minimum wage times 2,080 hours and rise automatically with it.
measures.noMeans: Supervisors' salary would stay at $1,045 per month as set in the County Charter.

measures.title: City of Red Bluff Appointed City Clerk and City Treasurer
measures.summary: Asks whether Red Bluff's City Clerk and City Treasurer should become positions appointed by the City Council instead of elected by voters. If approved, the Council could set professional qualifications and hire, manage and remove the Clerk and Treasurer, could delegate the appointment to the City Manager, and the officeholders would no longer need to live or be registered to vote in the city. The change would take effect when the current terms end in November 2028, or earlier if either office becomes vacant.
measures.yesMeans: Red Bluff's City Clerk and City Treasurer would become appointed positions.
measures.noMeans: Red Bluff's City Clerk and City Treasurer would continue to be elected by voters.
